en: Once upon a time there was a small town far from the city.
zh: 從前有一個遠離城市的小鎮。
ja: 昔々、都会から遠く離れた小さな町がありました。
local: Once upon a time there was a small town far from the city.
ja_pron: Mukashi mukashi, tokai kara tooku hanareta chiisana machi ga arimashita.
native: Once upon a time there was a small town far from the city.

en: In this town lived a witch whom everyone made fun of.
zh: 這個鎮上住著一位被大家取笑的女巫。
ja: その町には、みんなにからかわれている魔女が住んでいました。
local: In this town lived a witch whom everyone made fun of.
ja_pron: Sono machi ni wa, minna ni karakawarete iru majo ga sunde imashita.
native: In this town lived a witch whom everyone made fun of.

en: This witch named Fury was so clumsy.
zh: 這位名叫Fury的女巫非常笨拙。
ja: その魔女の名前はフューリーで、とても不器用でした。
local: This witch named Fury was so clumsy.
ja_pron: Sono majo no namae wa Fyūrī de, totemo bukiyou deshita.
native: This witch named Fury was so clumsy.

en: One day, the witch Fury was preparing a potion to do her usual evil deeds.
zh: 有一天，女巫Fury正在準備藥水，準備做她平常的壞事。
ja: ある日、魔女フューリーはいつもの悪事をするための薬を準備していました。
local: One day, the witch Fury was preparing a potion to do her usual evil deeds.
ja_pron: Aru hi, majo Fyūrī wa itsumo no akuji o suru tame no kusuri o junbi shite imashita.
native: One day, the witch Fury was preparing a potion to do her usual evil deeds.

en: Bobby, get out of here!
zh: Bobby，快離開這裡！
ja: ボビー、ここから出て行きなさい！
local: Bobby, get out of here!
ja_pron: Bobī, koko kara dete ikinasai!
native: Bobby, get out of here!

en: He will pour out this potion of unhappiness that I will deal out to the people.
zh: 他會把這瓶不幸的藥水倒出來，我會把它施加給人們。
ja: 彼はこの不幸の薬をばらまくつもりで、私はそれを人々に与えます。
local: He will pour out this potion of unhappiness that I will deal out to the people.
ja_pron: Kare wa kono fukou no kusuri o baramaku tsumori de, watashi wa sore o hitobito ni ataemasu.
native: He will pour out this potion of unhappiness that I will deal out to the people.

en: Witch Fury's spoil dog was not standing still.
zh: 女巫Fury那隻被寵壞的狗不停地動來動去。
ja: 魔女フューリーの甘やかされた犬はじっとしていませんでした。
local: Witch Fury's spoil dog was not standing still.
ja_pron: Majo Fyūrī no amayakasa reta inu wa jitto shite imasen deshita.
native: Witch Fury's spoil dog was not standing still.

en: He was running around.
zh: 牠在四處奔跑。
ja: 彼は走り回っていました。
local: He was running around.
ja_pron: Kare wa hashirimawatte imashita.
native: He was running around.

en: Whoof!
zh: 汪！
ja: ワン！
local: Whoof!
ja_pron: Wan!
native: Whoof!

en: Bobby! Enough is enough!
zh: Bobby！夠了夠了！
ja: ボビー！もう十分だ！
local: Bobby! Enough is enough!
ja_pron: Bobī! Mou juubun da!
native: Bobby! Enough is enough!

en: Meanwhile, Witch Fury accidentally put too much sugar in the potion cauldron.
zh: 同時，女巫Fury不小心在藥水鍋裡放了太多糖。
ja: その間に、魔女フューリーは誤って薬の大釜に砂糖を入れすぎてしまいました。
local: Meanwhile, Witch Fury accidentally put too much sugar in the potion cauldron.
ja_pron: Sono aida ni, majo Fyūrī wa ayamatte kusuri no ōkama ni satō o iresugite shimaimashita.
native: Meanwhile, Witch Fury accidentally put too much sugar in the potion cauldron.

en: I didn't realize it.
zh: 我沒有注意到。
ja: 気づきませんでした。
local: I didn't realize it.
ja_pron: Kidzukimasen deshita.
native: I didn't realize it.

en: When she took the potion she filled in a small bottle and started casting spells.
zh: 當她把藥水裝進小瓶子裡，開始施法時。
ja: 彼女が薬を小瓶に入れて呪文を唱え始めました。
local: When she took the potion she filled in a small bottle and started casting spells.
ja_pron: Kanojo ga kusuri o kobin ni irete jumon o tonae hajimemashita.
native: When she took the potion she filled in a small bottle and started casting spells.

en: Let the laughter turn into tears!
zh: 讓笑聲變成眼淚！
ja: 笑いを涙に変えろ！
local: Let the laughter turn into tears!
ja_pron: Warai o namida ni kaero!
native: Let the laughter turn into tears!

en: Joys into troubles and dreams into nightmares!
zh: 快樂變成麻煩，夢想變成噩夢！
ja: 喜びを困難に、夢を悪夢に変えろ！
local: Joys into troubles and dreams into nightmares!
ja_pron: Yorokobi o konnan ni, yume o akumu ni kaero!
native: Joys into troubles and dreams into nightmares!

en: Just then, spoiled Bobby got tangled in the witch's feet.
zh: 就在這時，被寵壞的Bobby纏住了女巫的腳。
ja: その時、甘やかされたボビーが魔女の足に絡まってしまいました。
local: Just then, spoiled Bobby got tangled in the witch's feet.
ja_pron: Sono toki, amayakasa reta Bobī ga majo no ashi ni karamatte shimaimashita.
native: Just then, spoiled Bobby got tangled in the witch's feet.

en: The witch stumbled and tripped on her broom next to the table.
zh: 女巫絆倒了，摔在桌子旁的掃帚上。
ja: 魔女はつまずいて、テーブルのそばのほうきに躓きました。
local: The witch stumbled and tripped on her broom next to the table.
ja_pron: Majo wa tsumazuite, tēburu no soba no hōki ni tsumazukimashita.
native: The witch stumbled and tripped on her broom next to the table.

en: And some of the potion in the bottle spilled onto the dog.
zh: 瓶子裡的一些藥水灑到了狗身上。
ja: そして瓶の中の薬の一部が犬にこぼれました。
local: And some of the potion in the bottle spilled onto the dog.
ja_pron: Soshite bin no naka no kusuri no ichibu ga inu ni koboremashita.
native: And some of the potion in the bottle spilled onto the dog.

en: Bobby didn't understand what happened first.
zh: Bobby一開始不明白發生了什麼事。
ja: ボビーは最初に何が起こったのか理解できませんでした。
local: Bobby didn't understand what happened first.
ja_pron: Bobī wa saisho ni nani ga okotta no ka rikai dekimasen deshita.
native: Bobby didn't understand what happened first.

en: Looked left and right, then turned into a giant candy.
zh: 牠左右看了看，然後變成了一顆巨大的糖果。
ja: 左右を見回し、それから巨大なキャンディーに変わりました。
local: Looked left and right, then turned into a giant candy.
ja_pron: Sayū o mimawashi, sorekara kyodaina kyandī ni kawarimashita.
native: Looked left and right, then turned into a giant candy.

en: Seeing this, Fury looked at the potion bottle and her dog, which had turned into a candy.
zh: 看到這一幕，Fury看著藥水瓶和變成糖果的狗。
ja: それを見て、フューリーは薬の瓶とキャンディーに変わった犬を見つめました。
local: Seeing this, Fury looked at the potion bottle and her dog, which had turned into a candy.
ja_pron: Sore o mite, Fyūrī wa kusuri no bin to kyandī ni kawatta inu o mitsumemashita.
native: Seeing this, Fury looked at the potion bottle and her dog, which had turned into a candy.

en: The candy was bouncing around and the witch was chasing after it anxiously.
zh: 糖果在跳動，女巫焦急地追著它。
ja: キャンディーが跳ね回り、魔女は不安そうにそれを追いかけました。
local: The candy was bouncing around and the witch was chasing after it anxiously.
ja_pron: Kyandī ga hanemawari, majo wa fuansō ni sore o oikakemashita.
native: The candy was bouncing around and the witch was chasing after it anxiously.

en: Bobby!
zh: Bobby！
ja: ボビー！
local: Bobby!
ja_pron: Bobī!
native: Bobby!

en: Do not go!
zh: 不要走！
ja: 行かないで！
local: Do not go!
ja_pron: Ikanaide!
native: Do not go!

en: I will fix this!
zh: 我會修好的！
ja: 直すから！
local: I will fix this!
ja_pron: Naosu kara!
native: I will fix this!

en: Wait!
zh: 等等！
ja: 待って！
local: Wait!
ja_pron: Matte!
native: Wait!

en: Ah!
zh: 啊！
ja: ああ！
local: Ah!
ja_pron: Aa!
native: Ah!

en: I said stop!
zh: 我說停下！
ja: 止まれって言ったでしょ！
local: I said stop!
ja_pron: Tomare tte itta desho!
native: I said stop!

en: Wait!
zh: 等等！
ja: 待って！
local: Wait!
ja_pron: Matte!
native: Wait!

en: The candy bounced around.
zh: 糖果跳來跳去。
ja: キャンディーが跳ね回りました。
local: The candy bounced around.
ja_pron: Kyandī ga hanemawarimashita.
native: The candy bounced around.

en: First, popped out of the window, then fell into the pool below, and of course melted in an instant.
zh: 先是跳出窗外，然後掉進下面的水池，當然瞬間就融化了。
ja: 最初は窓から飛び出し、その後下のプールに落ち、もちろんすぐに溶けてしまいました。
local: First, popped out of the window, then fell into the pool below, and of course melted in an instant.
ja_pron: Saisho wa mado kara tobidashi, sono ato shita no pūru ni ochi, mochiron sugu ni tokete shimaimashita.
native: First, popped out of the window, then fell into the pool below, and of course melted in an instant.

en: The witch Fury looked sadly behind the melting candy.
zh: 女巫Fury悲傷地看著融化的糖果。
ja: 魔女フューリーは溶けていくキャンディーを悲しそうに見つめました。
local: The witch Fury looked sadly behind the melting candy.
ja_pron: Majo Fyūrī wa tokete iku kyandī o kanashisō ni mitsumemashita.
native: The witch Fury looked sadly behind the melting candy.

en: This incident spread from peer to ear among the town's people.
zh: 這件事在鎮上人們之間傳開了。
ja: この出来事は町の人々の間で口コミで広まりました。
local: This incident spread from peer to ear among the town's people.
ja_pron: Kono dekigoto wa machi no hitobito no aida de kuchikomi de hiromarimashita.
native: This incident spread from peer to ear among the town's people.

en: Those who were fed up with the witch's evils thought she deserved it.
zh: 那些受夠女巫惡行的人認為她活該。
ja: 魔女の悪事にうんざりしていた人々は、彼女に当然の報いだと思いました。
local: Those who were fed up with the witch's evils thought she deserved it.
ja_pron: Majo no akuji ni unzari shite ita hitobito wa, kanojo ni tōzen no mukui da to omoimashita.
native: Those who were fed up with the witch's evils thought she deserved it.

en: The witch living in the haunted mansion has finally been punished for her wickedness.
zh: 住在鬧鬼大宅的女巫終於因她的邪惡受到了懲罰。
ja: 幽霊屋敷に住む魔女はついにその悪行の罰を受けました。
local: The witch living in the haunted mansion has finally been punished for her wickedness.
ja_pron: Yūrei yashiki ni sumu majo wa tsuini sono akuji no batsu o ukemashita.
native: The witch living in the haunted mansion has finally been punished for her wickedness.

en: Yeah, she won't be able to cast spells on us anymore.
zh: 是啊，她再也無法對我們施法了。
ja: そう、彼女はもう私たちに呪文をかけられません。
local: Yeah, she won't be able to cast spells on us anymore.
ja_pron: Sō, kanojo wa mō watashitachi ni jumon o kakeraremasen.
native: Yeah, she won't be able to cast spells on us anymore.

en: I think we should celebrate that.
zh: 我覺得我們應該慶祝這件事。
ja: それを祝うべきだと思います。
local: I think we should celebrate that.
ja_pron: Sore o iwau beki da to omoimasu.
native: I think we should celebrate that.

en: But she's just a clumsy witch, and she lost her dog just because of that.
zh: 但她只是個笨拙的女巫，因為這樣她失去了她的狗。
ja: でも彼女はただの不器用な魔女で、それが原因で犬を失いました。
local: But she's just a clumsy witch, and she lost her dog just because of that.
ja_pron: Demo kanojo wa tada no bukiyō na majo de, sore ga gen'in de inu o ushinai mashita.
native: But she's just a clumsy witch, and she lost her dog just because of that.

en: From that day on, the town's people celebrated the same day every year as Halloween.
zh: 從那天起，鎮上的人們每年同一天慶祝萬聖節。
ja: その日から、町の人々は毎年同じ日をハロウィンとして祝うようになりました。
local: From that day on, the town's people celebrated the same day every year as Halloween.
ja_pron: Sono hi kara, machi no hitobito wa maitoshi onaji hi o Harouin to shite iwa u yō ni narimashita.
native: From that day on, the town's people celebrated the same day every year as Halloween.

en: While the young girl named Millie was feeding street animals on the same day every year.
zh: 而年輕女孩Millie每年同一天都在餵街上的動物。
ja: 若い少女ミリーは毎年同じ日に街の動物に餌をあげていました。
local: While the young girl named Millie was feeding street animals on the same day every year.
ja_pron: Wakai shōjo Mirī wa maitoshi onaji hi ni machi no dōbutsu ni esa o agete imashita.
native: While the young girl named Millie was feeding street animals on the same day every year.

en: You're so playful, love's dog!
zh: 你真調皮，愛的狗！
ja: あなたはとても遊び好きね、ラブの犬！
local: You're so playful, love's dog!
ja_pron: Anata wa totemo asobi suki ne, Rabu no inu!
native: You're so playful, love's dog!

en: Jump!
zh: 跳！
ja: ジャンプ！
local: Jump!
ja_pron: Janpu!
native: Jump!

en: Come on, jump!
zh: 來，跳！
ja: さあ、ジャンプして！
local: Come on, jump!
ja_pron: Sā, janpu shite!
native: Come on, jump!

en: A few years have passed.
zh: 幾年過去了。
ja: 数年が経ちました。
local: A few years have passed.
ja_pron: Sūnen ga tachimashita.
native: A few years have passed.

en: The witch Fury began to devise a plan to punish those who made fun of her.
zh: 女巫Fury開始策劃懲罰那些嘲笑她的人。
ja: 魔女フューリーは自分をからかった人々を罰する計画を立て始めました。
local: The witch Fury began to devise a plan to punish those who made fun of her.
ja_pron: Majo Fyūrī wa jibun o karakatta hitobito o bassuru keikaku o tate hajimemashita.
native: The witch Fury began to devise a plan to punish those who made fun of her.

en: That year, on Halloween, she disguised herself and wore a huge pumpkin headdress.
zh: 那年萬聖節，她偽裝自己，戴上了巨大的南瓜頭飾。
ja: その年のハロウィンに、彼女は変装して大きなカボチャのかぶり物をしました。
local: That year, on Halloween, she disguised herself and wore a huge pumpkin headdress.
ja_pron: Sono toshi no Harouin ni, kanojo wa hensō shite ōkina kabocha no kaburimono o shimashita.
native: That year, on Halloween, she disguised herself and wore a huge pumpkin headdress.

en: In this way, she managed not to be recognized by anyone.
zh: 這樣，她成功沒被任何人認出來。
ja: こうして、彼女は誰にも気づかれませんでした。
local: In this way, she managed not to be recognized by anyone.
ja_pron: Kōshite, kanojo wa dare ni mo kidzukaremasen deshita.
native: In this way, she managed not to be recognized by anyone.

en: I will punish all of you for making fun of me.
zh: 我要懲罰所有嘲笑我的人。
ja: 私をからかった皆を罰してやる。
local: I will punish all of you for making fun of me.
ja_pron: Watashi o karakatta mina o basshite yaru.
native: I will punish all of you for making fun of me.

en: She took the potion bottle she had prepared and went out of her mansion for the first time in years.
zh: 她拿起準備好的藥水瓶，多年來第一次走出她的宅邸。
ja: 彼女は用意した薬の瓶を持ち、何年ぶりかで屋敷を出ました。
local: She took the potion bottle she had prepared and went out of her mansion for the first time in years.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa yōi shita kusuri no bin o mochi, nan-nen buri ka de yashiki o demashita.
native: She took the potion bottle she had prepared and went out of her mansion for the first time in years.

en: And started knocking on the doors one by one.
zh: 開始一戶一戶敲門。
ja: そして一軒ずつドアをノックし始めました。
local: And started knocking on the doors one by one.
ja_pron: Soshite ikken zutsu doa o nokku shi hajimemashita.
native: And started knocking on the doors one by one.

en: No one recognized the witch Fury.
zh: 沒有人認出女巫Fury。
ja: 誰も魔女フューリーだと気づきませんでした。
local: No one recognized the witch Fury.
ja_pron: Dare mo majo Fyūrī da to kidzukimasen deshita.
native: No one recognized the witch Fury.

en: Trick or treat?
zh: 不給糖就搗蛋？
ja: トリック・オア・トリート？
local: Trick or treat?
ja_pron: Torikku oa torīto?
native: Trick or treat?

en: Treat!
zh: 給糖！
ja: トリート！
local: Treat!
ja_pron: Torīto!
native: Treat!

en: When the witch heard the word candy, she sprayed the man with her potion and turned him into a giant candy.
zh: 當女巫聽到糖果這個詞時，她用藥水噴灑那個男人，並把他變成一顆巨大的糖果。
ja: 魔女はキャンディーという言葉を聞くと、その男に薬を吹きかけ、巨大なキャンディーに変えました。
local: When the witch heard the word candy, she sprayed the man with her potion and turned him into a giant candy.
ja_pron: Majo wa kyandī to iu kotoba o kiku to, sono otoko ni kusuri o fukikake, kyodaina kyandī ni kaemashita.
native: When the witch heard the word candy, she sprayed the man with her potion and turned him into a giant candy.

en: Ha ha ha ha!
zh: 哈哈哈哈！
ja: はははは！
local: Ha ha ha ha!
ja_pron: Hahaha!
native: Ha ha ha ha!

en: Now make fun of me!
zh: 現在嘲笑我吧！
ja: さあ、私をからかってみろ！
local: Now make fun of me!
ja_pron: Sā, watashi o karakatte miro!
native: Now make fun of me!

en: Then the witch went to the house next door.
zh: 然後女巫走向隔壁的房子。
ja: それから魔女は隣の家に行きました。
local: Then the witch went to the house next door.
ja_pron: Sorekara majo wa tonari no ie ni ikimashita.
native: Then the witch went to the house next door.

en: This time, a kid opened the door.
zh: 這次，一個小孩開了門。
ja: 今度は子供がドアを開けました。
local: This time, a kid opened the door.
ja_pron: Kondo wa kodomo ga doa o akemashita.
native: This time, a kid opened the door.

en: Trick or treat?
zh: 不給糖就搗蛋？
ja: トリック・オア・トリート？
local: Trick or treat?
ja_pron: Torikku oa torīto?
native: Trick or treat?

en: Treat!
zh: 給糖！
ja: トリート！
local: Treat!
ja_pron: Torīto!
native: Treat!

en: Here you go, treat!
zh: 給你，糖果！
ja: はい、トリート！
local: Here you go, treat!
ja_pron: Hai, torīto!
native: Here you go, treat!

en: Witch Fury turned the kid into a candy right there.
zh: 女巫Fury當場把小孩變成了糖果。
ja: 魔女フューリーはその場で子供をキャンディーに変えました。
local: Witch Fury turned the kid into a candy right there.
ja_pron: Majo Fyūrī wa sono ba de kodomo o kyandī ni kaemashita.
native: Witch Fury turned the kid into a candy right there.

en: Meanwhile, Millie, who was out to feed the street animals, was very surprised to see huge candies bouncing around.
zh: 同時，外出餵街上動物的Millie看到巨大的糖果跳來跳去，非常驚訝。
ja: その間、街の動物に餌をあげに出ていたミリーは、巨大なキャンディーが跳ね回っているのを見てとても驚きました。
local: Meanwhile, Millie, who was out to feed the street animals, was very surprised to see huge candies bouncing around.
ja_pron: Sono aida, machi no dōbutsu ni esa o age ni dete ita Mirī wa, kyodaina kyandī ga hanemawatte iru no o mite totemo odorokimashita.
native: Meanwhile, Millie, who was out to feed the street animals, was very surprised to see huge candies bouncing around.

en: What?
zh: 什麼？
ja: 何？
local: What?
ja_pron: Nani?
native: What?

en: What's going on here?
zh: 這裡發生了什麼事？
ja: ここで何が起こっているの？
local: What's going on here?
ja_pron: Koko de nani ga okotte iru no?
native: What's going on here?

en: Where are those candies coming from?
zh: 那些糖果是從哪裡來的？
ja: あのキャンディーはどこから来たの？
local: Where are those candies coming from?
ja_pron: Ano kyandī wa doko kara kita no?
native: Where are those candies coming from?

en: Millie ran in the direction the candies were bouncing.
zh: Millie朝著糖果跳動的方向跑去。
ja: ミリーはキャンディーが跳ねている方向へ走りました。
local: Millie ran in the direction the candies were bouncing.
ja_pron: Mirī wa kyandī ga hanete iru hōkō e hashirimashita.
native: Millie ran in the direction the candies were bouncing.

en: And she saw that someone in a pumpkin costume was laughing at the candy that passed in front of her.
zh: 她看到一個穿著南瓜裝的人在笑著經過她面前的糖果。
ja: そして彼女は、カボチャの衣装を着た誰かが目の前を通り過ぎるキャンディーを笑っているのを見ました。
local: And she saw that someone in a pumpkin costume was laughing at the candy that passed in front of her.
ja_pron: Soshite kanojo wa, kabocha no ishou o kita dareka ga me no mae o tōrisugiru kyandī o waratte iru no o mimashita.
native: And she saw that someone in a pumpkin costume was laughing at the candy that passed in front of her.

en: Hey!
zh: 嘿！
ja: ねえ！
local: Hey!
ja_pron: Nē!
native: Hey!

en: Who are you?
zh: 你是誰？
ja: あなたは誰？
local: Who are you?
ja_pron: Anata wa dare?
native: Who are you?

en: What are you doing to these people?
zh: 你對這些人做了什麼？
ja: この人たちに何をしているの？
local: What are you doing to these people?
ja_pron: Kono hitotachi ni nani o shite iru no?
native: What are you doing to these people?

en: Stop now!
zh: 現在停止！
ja: 今すぐやめて！
local: Stop now!
ja_pron: Ima sugu yamete!
native: Stop now!

en: When the witch saw the young girl who was coming, running to her, she started to run away quickly.
zh: 當女巫看到那個跑向她的年輕女孩時，她開始迅速逃跑。
ja: 魔女は走って近づいてくる若い少女を見て、急いで逃げ始めました。
local: When the witch saw the young girl who was coming, running to her, she started to run away quickly.
ja_pron: Majo wa hashitte chikadzuite kuru wakai shōjo o mite, isoide nige hajimemashita.
native: When the witch saw the young girl who was coming, running to her, she started to run away quickly.

en: They chased each other along the street.
zh: 他們在街上互相追逐。
ja: 彼らは通りで追いかけっこをしました。
local: They chased each other along the street.
ja_pron: Karera wa tōri de oikakekko o shimashita.
native: They chased each other along the street.

en: Finally, Millie caught this oddly disguised witch, and took off her hood.
zh: 最後，Millie抓住了這個奇怪偽裝的女巫，並脫下了她的帽子。
ja: ついにミリーは奇妙に変装した魔女を捕まえ、フードを脱がせました。
local: Finally, Millie caught this oddly disguised witch, and took off her hood.
ja_pron: Tsuini Mirī wa kimyō ni hensō shita majo o tsukamae, fūdo o nugasemashita.
native: Finally, Millie caught this oddly disguised witch, and took off her hood.

en: She was very surprised to see that it was witch Fury.
zh: 她非常驚訝地發現那是女巫Fury。
ja: それが魔女フューリーだと知ってとても驚きました。
local: She was very surprised to see that it was witch Fury.
ja_pron: Sore ga majo Fyūrī da to shitte totemo odorokimashita.
native: She was very surprised to see that it was witch Fury.

en: Ah ha!
zh: 啊哈！
ja: あは！
local: Ah ha!
ja_pron: Aha!
native: Ah ha!

en: Witch Fury!
zh: 女巫Fury！
ja: 魔女フューリー！
local: Witch Fury!
ja_pron: Majo Fyūrī!
native: Witch Fury!

en: It's you!
zh: 是你！
ja: あなたなのね！
local: It's you!
ja_pron: Anata nano ne!
native: It's you!

en: Where are you doing evil things to people again after years?
zh: 多年後你又在對人們做壞事嗎？
ja: 何年も経ってまた人々に悪さをしているの？
local: Where are you doing evil things to people again after years?
ja_pron: Nannen mo tatte mata hitobito ni warusa o shite iru no?
native: Where are you doing evil things to people again after years?

en: You should stop now!
zh: 你現在應該停止了！
ja: もうやめたほうがいいよ！
local: You should stop now!
native: You should stop now!

en: The townspeople deserve it, Millie!
zh: 鎮上的人們應得這樣，米莉！
ja: 町の人たちはそれに値するよ、ミリー！
local: The townspeople deserve it, Millie!
native: The townspeople deserve it, Millie!

en: While I'm sad to lose my dog, they're celebrating this day!
zh: 雖然我很難過失去我的狗，但他們正在慶祝這一天！
ja: 犬を失って悲しいけれど、みんなはこの日を祝っているんだ！
local: While I'm sad to lose my dog, they're celebrating this day!
native: While I'm sad to lose my dog, they're celebrating this day!

en: Millie realized that the witch Fury was very sorry for her dog, and that she has actually been alone for years.
zh: 米莉意識到女巫弗瑞很為她的狗感到抱歉，而且她其實已經孤獨多年。
ja: ミリーは、魔女フューリーが自分の犬をとても気の毒に思っていて、実は何年も一人でいたことに気づいた。
local: Millie realized that the witch Fury was very sorry for her dog, and that she has actually been alone for years.
native: Millie realized that the witch Fury was very sorry for her dog, and that she has actually been alone for years.

en: I understand you, but the solution is not to hurt people!
zh: 我理解你，但解決方法不是傷害別人！
ja: 君の気持ちはわかるけど、解決策は人を傷つけることじゃない！
local: I understand you, but the solution is not to hurt people!
native: I understand you, but the solution is not to hurt people!

en: Kindness always wins!
zh: 善良總是會勝利！
ja: 優しさはいつも勝つ！
local: Kindness always wins!
native: Kindness always wins!

en: I have a great idea!
zh: 我有個好主意！
ja: いい考えがあるよ！
local: I have a great idea!
native: I have a great idea!

en: Wait a minute!
zh: 等一下！
ja: ちょっと待って！
local: Wait a minute!
native: Wait a minute!

en: Millie embraced the little puppy, who was trying to play with the bouncing candies in the square, and brought him to the witch.
zh: 米莉抱起那隻試圖和廣場上跳動的糖果玩耍的小狗，並帶他去找女巫。
ja: ミリーは広場で跳ねるキャンディーと遊ぼうとしていた子犬を抱きしめて、魔女のところへ連れて行った。
local: Millie embraced the little puppy, who was trying to play with the bouncing candies in the square, and brought him to the witch.
native: Millie embraced the little puppy, who was trying to play with the bouncing candies in the square, and brought him to the witch.

en: Here, look!
zh: 看這裡！
ja: ほら、見て！
local: Here, look!
native: Here, look!

en: How innocent is he?
zh: 他多麼純真無邪？
ja: なんて無邪気なんだろう？
local: How innocent is he?
native: How innocent is he?

en: This beautiful creature may now want to live with you!
zh: 這個美麗的生物現在可能想和你一起生活！
ja: この美しい生き物は今、あなたと一緒に暮らしたいと思っているかもしれない！
local: This beautiful creature may now want to live with you!
native: This beautiful creature may now want to live with you!

en: Witch Fury was overjoyed when she saw the dog, because he looked just like her old dog, Bobby!
zh: 當女巫弗瑞看到這隻狗時，她欣喜若狂，因為牠看起來就像她的老狗鮑比！
ja: 魔女フューリーはその犬を見て大喜びした。なぜなら、まるで彼女の昔の犬ボビーそっくりだったから！
local: Witch Fury was overjoyed when she saw the dog, because he looked just like her old dog, Bobby!
native: Witch Fury was overjoyed when she saw the dog, because he looked just like her old dog, Bobby!

en: But this, he looks a lot like my dog!
zh: 但是這隻，他看起來很像我的狗！
ja: でもこれは、僕の犬にそっくりだ！
local: But this, he looks a lot like my dog!
native: But this, he looks a lot like my dog!

en: I can't believe it!
zh: 我不敢相信！
ja: 信じられない！
local: I can't believe it!
native: I can't believe it!

en: Oh, he's so sweet!
zh: 喔，他真可愛！
ja: ああ、彼はとてもかわいい！
local: Oh, he's so sweet!
native: Oh, he's so sweet!

en: If you promise to stop doing evil to the townspeople, this puppy can live with you for a lifetime, and be very happy!
zh: 如果你答應不再對鎮上的人做壞事，這隻小狗可以和你一起生活一輩子，非常快樂！
ja: もし町の人たちに悪さをやめると約束するなら、この子犬は一生あなたと一緒に暮らして、とても幸せになれるよ！
local: If you promise to stop doing evil to the townspeople, this puppy can live with you for a lifetime, and be very happy!
native: If you promise to stop doing evil to the townspeople, this puppy can live with you for a lifetime, and be very happy!

en: The witch's heart became softer as she loved the dog, the evil in her suddenly disappeared.
zh: 女巫的心因為愛上這隻狗而變得柔軟，她身上的邪惡突然消失了。
ja: 魔女は犬を愛するにつれて心が柔らかくなり、彼女の中の悪が突然消えた。
local: The witch's heart became softer as she loved the dog, the evil in her suddenly disappeared.
native: The witch's heart became softer as she loved the dog, the evil in her suddenly disappeared.

en: I promise, this dog will now be my best friend!
zh: 我保證，這隻狗現在會是我最好的朋友！
ja: 約束する、この犬はこれから私の一番の友達になる！
local: I promise, this dog will now be my best friend!
native: I promise, this dog will now be my best friend!

en: Thank you, young girl!
zh: 謝謝你，小女孩！
ja: ありがとう、若い女の子！
local: Thank you, young girl!
native: Thank you, young girl!

en: The witch, with her newly adopted dog, turned all the candies that were bouncing on the street back to their old human form.
zh: 女巫帶著她新收養的狗，將街上跳動的糖果全都變回了原本的人形。
ja: 魔女は新しく迎えた犬と一緒に、街で跳ねていたキャンディーをすべて元の人間の姿に戻した。
local: The witch, with her newly adopted dog, turned all the candies that were bouncing on the street back to their old human form.
native: The witch, with her newly adopted dog, turned all the candies that were bouncing on the street back to their old human form.

en: She named her beloved dog, Candy.
zh: 她給她心愛的狗取名叫糖果。
ja: 彼女は愛犬にキャンディーと名付けた。
local: She named her beloved dog, Candy.
native: She named her beloved dog, Candy.

en: Since then, Fury has gone out on the streets to do the street animals of favor every Halloween.
zh: 從那時起，弗瑞每年萬聖節都會走上街頭幫助街上的動物。
ja: それ以来、フューリーは毎年ハロウィンに街に出て、街の動物たちのために尽くしている。
local: Since then, Fury has gone out on the streets to do the street animals of favor every Halloween.
native: Since then, Fury has gone out on the streets to do the street animals of favor every Halloween.

en: Just like Millie!
zh: 就像米莉一樣！
ja: ミリーと同じように！
local: Just like Millie!
native: Just like Millie!

en: And her dog, Candy, has never left her alone!
zh: 而她的狗糖果從未離開過她！
ja: そして彼女の犬キャンディーは決して彼女を一人にしなかった！
local: And her dog, Candy, has never left her alone!
native: And her dog, Candy, has never left her alone!
